data.title: A map on the farm gate
data.goal: A map on the farm gate

memoryNodes.cue: The map shows how the fields connect to the shop.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 地图显示田地如何通到小店。

memoryNodes.cue: A vehicle moves across the land used for farming.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 一辆车辆驶过耕作用地。

memoryNodes.cue: The farmer explains what the field can grow.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 农夫解释田地能种什么。

data.situation:
On Saturday, Lin and Maya took the early bus to a farm that supplied the River Street market. A map on the gate showed fields, a barn and a small shop. Beyond the fence, a tractor moved slowly across a strip of agricultural land. Lin could see the town’s new buildings on the far horizon, but here the first sounds were an engine and birds. Farmer: Agriculture is our work, but each field has a different job. This crop is grown for food. That smaller plot is for a trial.
Lin: The soil looks dark.
Farmer: It’s fertile, though the colour alone can’t tell you everything. We check it before planting. Cultivation starts long before you see a field of green. Field visit
Please stay with the farmer while the tractor is working. Use the path beside the fence. Meet at the gate after the visit; the farm shop is on the other side of the barn.

readingBlocks.en: On Saturday, Lin and Maya took the early bus to a farm that supplied the River Street market. A map on the gate showed fields, a barn and a small shop. Beyond the fence, a tractor moved slowly across a strip of agricultural land. Lin could see the town’s new buildings on the far horizon, but here the first sounds were an engine and birds.
readingBlocks.zh: 周六，林和玛雅乘早班公交去给河街集市供货的一座农场。大门上的地图标着田地、谷仓和小店。篱笆那边，一辆拖拉机缓缓驶过一片农业用地。林能看见远处地平线上的城镇新楼，不过这里最先传来的声音是发动机和鸟鸣。

readingBlocks.en:
Farmer: Agriculture is our work, but each field has a different job. This crop is grown for food. That smaller plot is for a trial.
Lin: The soil looks dark.
Farmer: It’s fertile, though the colour alone can’t tell you everything. We check it before planting. Cultivation starts long before you see a field of green.
readingBlocks.zh:
农夫：农业是我们的工作，不过每块田有不同用途。这种作物是作为食物种的，那块小田用来试验。
林：土看起来很黑。
农夫：它很肥沃，不过仅凭颜色不能看出全部。种植前我们会检查。栽培开始的时间，远比你看到一片绿色的田地要早。

readingBlocks.en:
Field visit
Please stay with the farmer while the tractor is working. Use the path beside the fence. Meet at the gate after the visit; the farm shop is on the other side of the barn.
readingBlocks.zh:
田间参访
拖拉机工作时，请跟着农夫走。使用篱笆旁的小路。参访后在大门集合；农场小店在谷仓另一侧。

glossary.zh: 农业；耕作实践或相关科学
glossary.note: 不可数名词，指耕种和养殖等农业活动。
glossary.example: Agriculture is the farmer’s main work.
glossary.exampleZh: 农业是农夫的主要工作。

externalEvidence.definition: the practice of cultivating the land or raising stock

glossary.zh: 为食物等用途种植的农作物
glossary.note: 本句为种植的植物；a crop/crops，不是本次收成总量。
glossary.example: This crop is grown for food.
glossary.exampleZh: 这种作物是作为食物种植的。

externalEvidence.definition: a cultivated plant that is grown commercially on a large scale

glossary.note: 可数名词；本例是田间农用车辆。
glossary.example: A tractor moves slowly across the field.
glossary.exampleZh: 一辆拖拉机缓缓驶过田地。

externalEvidence.definition: a wheeled vehicle with large wheels; used in farming and other applications

glossary.zh: 能支持植物生长的；肥沃的
glossary.note: fertile soil/land；这里指土壤适合生长。
本句为耕种与培育植物；不是培养兴趣的比喻用法。
glossary.example: Cultivation starts before the first green shoots appear.
glossary.exampleZh: 栽培在第一批绿芽出现之前就开始了。

externalEvidence.definition: the act of raising or growing plants (especially on a large scale)

glossary.note: 组合表达，agricultural修饰land；本句为实际农田。
glossary.example: The tractor crosses a strip of agricultural land.
glossary.exampleZh: 拖拉机驶过一片农业用地。
